confidenceBinding.attribution: operator-declared local source; byte/sequence pairing verified, authorship not authenticated

checks.reason: Scale comes from method/producer and local metrics, never from numeric magnitude alone.
No confidence filter requested; no residues are removed.
Mapping uses atom-site keys. Author insertion codes and ambiguous alternate observations are refused; no UniProt/SIFTS offset is inferred.
Every requested position requires one finite CA; no automatic dropping of units or residues.

threshold.reducer: max of both directed cross-unit blocks

checks.reason: Same previously fixed engineering profile as AFDB; neither local confidence nor PAE establishes physical plausibility.

Poly-His is a review signal, not proof of an engineered tag. No automatic trimming. Other construct metadata require sequence/source interpretation; absence of a motif does not prove a native construct.
No assembly or annotation diagnosis can be made from this coordinate file alone.

threshold.needed: independently reviewed units in the same frame

checks.reason: Supplied units are not their own validation reference.
Pratt et al. report confident but implausible repeat models. Passing pLDDT/PAE does not establish a physically plausible fold; these controls do not detect all published failures.

limitations: Mechanical screening; a complete R3.8 evaluation needs independent labels and pertinent controls.
No physical fold classifier, genomic assembly validator, SIFTS/UniProt alignment or repeat detector.
Integrity and declared sources do not authenticate scientific provenance.
